definition: The bounded cross-disciplinary capability library from which deterministic onboarding selects a researcher's foundation. It is not a mandate to install every skill for every user.

skills.rationale: Lets every researcher preserve new recurring work without waiting for a central catalog.
Finds scholarly records and available full text with provenance.
Verifies, deduplicates, and formats references.
Checks claims, assumptions, bias, and evidence strength.
Turns PDFs and other supported documents into inspectable text.
Extracts claim-linked passages, tables, figures, and page provenance from source documents.
Supports transparent searching, screening, synthesis, and bibliography verification.
Provides protocol-driven search, screening, deduplication, and review flow.
Turns observations into falsifiable hypotheses, rivals, and predictions.
Builds defensible study and experiment designs.
Freezes hypotheses, outcomes, exclusions, and analysis decisions before observation.
Calculates power, sample size, sensitivity, and detectable effects.
Retrieves structured facts through documented database interfaces.
Records cleaning decisions, transformations, exclusions, and lineage.
Profiles data quality, missingness, leakage, and sensitivity.
Plans and reports analyses with diagnostics, effects, and uncertainty.
Checks units and propagates measurement uncertainty.
Maintains traceable coding, excerpts, reflexivity, and bounded themes.
Tracks image identity, transformations, measurement, and interpretation limits.
Produces truthful, accessible, publication-oriented figures.
Creates versionable diagrams and structured research explanations.
Produces evidence-bounded scientific and academic text.
Reviews claims, methods, statistics, ethics, and reproducibility.
Builds and validates LaTeX manuscripts, equations, references, and venue constraints.
Captures environments, commands, seeds, inputs, outputs, and rerun checks.
Plans naming, storage, metadata, access, retention, and safe sharing.
Maintains a dated record of decisions, deviations, failures, and evidence changes.
